messages:
maria: Heads-up — SIEM fired ~3k KMS access alerts in the last 10m for project infra-builds. Looks clustered around ci-service-prod. Anyone on deploys?
sec-bot: ALERT: KMS_USAGE_ANOMALY threshold exceeded for project 'infra-builds'. link: https://siem.internal/alerts/98765 :rotating_light:
ashok: I pushed an RBAC tweak 09:12 to let the CI service read test keys. That could explain a spike.
dmitri: Logs show principal=ci-service-prod, action=Decrypt, resource=projects/redwood-*/locations/global/keyRings/*/cryptoKeys/*
```
ts=2026-03-20T09:15:03Z principal=ci-service-prod action=Decrypt key=projects/redwood-infra/... request_id=abc123
```
olivia: This is noisy — rule currently flags any Decrypt by non-human principals. We should exclude known CI service accounts or switch to anomaly scoring (e.g., cross-project decrypts within 5m).
maria: Containment plan: don't block yet. Add a short suppression for ci-service-prod for 30m and update the detection logic.
dmitri: I'll roll a suppression rule now. Proposal: require pattern of lateral KMS access (same principal hitting >3 distinct projects in 5m) before alerting.
ashok: I'll add asset_tag=ci-pool to pipeline logs so we can filter these out in SIEM. Deploying change in ~20m.
olivia: Also ensure KMS request_context (key alias + caller ip) is logged — makes rules more precise. Update playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/kms-usage :memo:
maria: Created INFSEC-3124 to do the rule refactor + dashboard updates. Owners: @dmitri @olivia. We'll monitor for 24h after change. :white_check_mark:
dmitri: Suppression applied (rule_id=4321). Added a dashboard panel for suppressed hits. Will report back in 1h with counts.
sec-bot: Update: suppression active. Alert rate reduced ~95% in 10m. :eyes:
